page.overview:
What is Coram Agh Tera?

Some scholars stipulate that the Dauk and Wozgor religions contributed to the creation of the cult, as many of their beliefs are still instilled into it.

Coram Agh Tera is depicted in many forms. Some portray the deity as a monstrous spider hidden in darkness, while others describe an incomprehensible being existing beyond reality, weaving an enormous web that connects all living beings.

Followers of the Lionheaded Spider believe that Coram Agh Tera is the Great Weaver, an entity that creates and controls the threads of destiny. Human lives are seen as threads within its great web, constantly being woven, repaired, or cut. Sudden deaths are believed to occur when Coram Agh Tera breaks a person's thread.

The origins of the Cult of Coram Agh Tera remain uncertain. Some scholars believe that elements of the religion were influenced by older Dauk and Wozgor traditions, as traces of their beliefs can still be found within the cult.
